def test_real_catalog_and_chat_http_with_bundled_unreviewed_content():
    """Actual API process + actual chatbot HTTP; static source, no DB/LLM/Redis calls."""
    api_python = (
        REPO / "backend/api/.venv" / ("Scripts/python.exe" if os.name == "nt" else "bin/python")
    )
    if not api_python.exists():
        pytest.skip("Existing API virtualenv is required; no dependency installation")

    def port():
        with socket.socket() as sock:
            sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
            return sock.getsockname()[1]

    api_port, chat_port = port(), port()
    api_url, chat_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{api_port}", f"http://127.0.0.1:{chat_port}"
    api_code = f"""
import uvicorn
from app.main import create_app
from app.repositories.style_look_repository import StyleLookRepository
from app.services.style_look_service import StyleLookService, get_style_look_service

class EmptyVerifiedStyleLinks:
    async def links(self, *, source):
        assert source == "style"
        return []

app = create_app()
app.dependency_overrides[get_style_look_service] = lambda: StyleLookService(
    StyleLookRepository(), EmptyVerifiedStyleLinks()
)
uvicorn.run(app,host="127.0.0.1",port={api_port},access_log=False,log_level="warning")
"""
    chat_code = f"""
from app.main import create_app
from app.services.chat_service import ChatService, get_chat_service
from app.clients.catalog_client import CatalogClient
import uvicorn
class DisabledLlm:
    configured = False
    async def complete(self, messages):
        raise AssertionError("No LLM calls allowed")
app = create_app()
catalog = CatalogClient({api_url!r})
app.dependency_overrides[get_chat_service] = lambda: ChatService(None, DisabledLlm(), catalog)
uvicorn.run(app,host="127.0.0.1",port={chat_port},access_log=False,log_level="warning")
"""
    env = os.environ | {
        "ENV": "local",
        "REDIS_URL": "",
        "LOG_LEVEL": "WARNING",
        "DATABASE_URL": "postgresql+asyncpg://unused:unused@127.0.0.1:1/unused",
        "SKINCARE_REFRESH_ENABLED": "false",
        "CATALOG_API_URL": api_url,
        "LLM_API_KEY": "",
        "LLM_MODEL": "",
        "CHAT_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE": "1000",
    }
    processes = []
    try:
        for cwd, executable, script in (
            (REPO / "backend/api", api_python, api_code),
            (REPO / "backend/chatbot", Path(sys.executable), chat_code),
        ):
            processes.append(
                subprocess.Popen(
                    [str(executable), "-B", "-c", script],
                    cwd=cwd,
                    env=env,
                    stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0),
                )
            )
        with httpx.Client(timeout=5, trust_env=False) as client:
            for url in (api_url + "/healthz", chat_url + "/healthz"):
                deadline = time.monotonic() + 12
                while True:
                    try:
                        health = client.get(url)
                        if health.status_code == 200:
                            break
                        last_error = f"HTTP {health.status_code}: {health.text[:500]}"
                    except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
                        last_error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
                    assert time.monotonic() < deadline, f"Health check {url} failed: {last_error}"
                    time.sleep(0.1)
            looks = client.get(api_url + "/api/style-looks")
            assert looks.status_code == 200, (
                f"GET /api/style-looks returned HTTP {looks.status_code}: {looks.text[:500]}"
            )
            look_id = looks.json()["looks"][0]["id"]
            body = {
                "message": "이 스타일은 어떻게 따라 해?",
                "requestType": "style_consultation",
                "locale": "ko",
                "styleContext": {"kind": "video", "lookId": look_id},
            }
            headers = {"X-Vishue-Anonymous-Id": "p04s-integration-guest-0123456789-abcdefghijk"}
            response = client.post(chat_url + "/api/chat", json=body, headers=headers)
            assert response.status_code == 200
            data = response.json()
            assert data["styleRecipe"]["basis"] == "video_metadata"
            assert data["styleRecipe"]["lookId"] == look_id
            assert data["styleRecipe"]["steps"] and data["products"] == []
            assert (
                not data["styleRecipe"]["arEligible"] and not data["styleRecipe"]["videoAnalyzed"]
            )
            body.update(message="다음 단계", styleContext=data["styleContext"])
            follow = client.post(chat_url + "/api/chat", json=body, headers=headers)
            assert follow.status_code == 200
            assert follow.json()["styleContext"]["currentStep"] == 1
    finally:
        for process in processes:
            process.terminate()
            try:
                process.wait(timeout=5)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                process.kill()
                process.wait(timeout=5)

@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_catalog_budget_and_followup_use_one_interpretation_each():
    llm = PlanLlm(intent="search", category="lip", maxPriceKRW=20000)
    catalog = Catalog()
    service = ChatService(FakeGraph(), llm, catalog)
    result = await service.answer(request())
    assert llm.calls == 1
    assert [p.id for p in result.products] == ["a", "b"]
    assert result.supervisor.plan.tasks == ["beauty"]
    assert result.supervisor.result.product_ids == ["a", "b"]
    assert all(e.source == "catalog_api" for e in result.supervisor.result.evidence)
    llm.plan = dict(intent="detail", scope="previous", ordinal=2)
    followup = await service.answer(request("두 번째 제품 가격은?", result.chat_context))
    assert llm.calls == 2
    assert followup.chat_context.candidate_ids == ["a", "b"]
    assert followup.chat_context.filters.max_price_krw == 20000
    assert [p.id for p in followup.products] == ["b"]
    assert "supervisor" not in followup.model_dump(mode="json")
    assert "toolResult" not in followup.model_dump(mode="json")
    assert ChatResponse.model_validate(followup.model_dump()).products == followup.products

class SafeState(TypedDict):
    result_ref: str
    execution_status: str


async def test_execution_locks_share_but_delete_remains_exclusive(record_property):
    from langgraph.checkpoint.postgres import PostgresSaver

    from app.repositories.checkpoint_repository import CheckpointRepository, _lock_thread

    url = make_url(URL)
    assert url.database == "vishue_chat_test"
    dsn = url.set(drivername="postgresql").render_as_string(hide_password=False)
    thread = uuid4()
    with (
        PostgresSaver.from_conn_string(dsn) as first,
        PostgresSaver.from_conn_string(dsn) as second,
    ):
        _lock_thread(first, thread, shared=True)
        _lock_thread(second, thread, shared=True)
        with pytest.raises(OSError, match="Checkpoint thread is busy"):
            await CheckpointRepository(URL).delete_thread(thread)
    await CheckpointRepository(URL).delete_thread(thread)
    record_property(
        "checkpoint_lock_boundary",
        "actual PG: shared execution; exclusive deletion blocked until both readers close",
    )


async def test_explicit_setup_and_safe_checkpoint_roundtrip():
    url = make_url(URL)
    if url.database != "vishue_chat_test":
        raise RuntimeError("G7 integration tests require the disposable vishue_chat_test database")
    dsn = url.set(drivername="postgresql").render_as_string(hide_password=False)
    thread = str(uuid4())
    async with AsyncPostgresSaver.from_conn_string(dsn) as saver:
        await saver.setup()
        await saver.setup()
        graph = StateGraph(SafeState)
        graph.add_node("finish", lambda state: {"execution_status": "done"})
        graph.add_edge(START, "finish")
        graph.add_edge("finish", END)
        compiled = graph.compile(checkpointer=saver)
        config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": thread}}
        await compiled.ainvoke({"result_ref": "safe-reference", "execution_status": "new"}, config)
        saved = await saver.aget_tuple(config)
        assert saved.checkpoint["channel_values"]["result_ref"] == "safe-reference"
        assert saved.checkpoint["channel_values"]["execution_status"] == "done"
        assert "ChatResponse" not in str(saved.checkpoint)
        assert "sessionToken" not in str(saved.checkpoint)
        await saver.adelete_thread(thread)
        assert await saver.aget_tuple(config) is None

def test_real_checkpoint_cancel_then_replacement_before_old_finishes(api, record_property):
    import asyncio
    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
    from threading import Event

    from app.schemas.supervisor import TaskPlan
    from app.services.chat_service import resolve_context, route_intent
    from app.services.product_consultation_graph import SupervisorRuntime

    client, _ = api
    entered, release = Event(), Event()
    errors = []

    class DurableChat:
        async def answer(self, req, principal):
            async def execute(*args):
                if req.message == "old durable read":
                    entered.set()
                    assert await asyncio.to_thread(release.wait, 20)
                return ChatResponse(answer=req.message + " result", products=[])

            context = resolve_context(req)
            runtime = SupervisorRuntime(
                req, context, lambda *_: TaskPlan(tasks=["beauty"]), execute
            )
            try:
                return await ChatService._run_durable(
                    req._g7_execution, runtime, route_intent(context)
                )
            except OSError as exc:
                errors.append({"class": type(exc).__name__, "reason": str(exc)})
                raise

    client.app.dependency_overrides[get_chat_service] = lambda: DurableChat()
    room = create(client)[0]["conversationId"]
    request_id = str(uuid4())
    body = {"conversationId": room, "requestId": request_id, "expectedConversationVersion": 0,
            "message": "old durable read", "locale": "en"}
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as pool:
        pending = pool.submit(client.post, "/api/chat", json=body, headers=AUTH)
        try:
            assert entered.wait(15)
            cancelled = client.post(
                f"/api/chat/conversations/{room}/requests/{request_id}/cancel", headers=AUTH
            )
            assert cancelled.status_code == 200
            replacement_body = {**body, "requestId": str(uuid4()), "message": "new durable read"}
            replacement = client.post("/api/chat", json=replacement_body, headers=AUTH)
            record_property("real_checkpoint_replacement", json.dumps({
                "postgres": "actual", "checkpoint": "actual durable_supervisor/fresh_writer",
                "model": "controlled mock; zero external calls", "oldReleased": release.is_set(),
                "replacementStatus": replacement.status_code, "errors": errors,
            }))
            assert replacement.status_code == 200, replacement.text
            assert not release.is_set()
        finally:
            release.set()
        late = pending.result(timeout=30)
    assert late.status_code == 409
    assert late.json()["code"] == "request_interrupted"
    restored = client.get(f"/api/chat/conversations/{room}", headers=AUTH).json()
    assert [m["text"] for m in restored["messages"]] == [
        "new durable read", "new durable read result"
    ]
    replay = client.post("/api/chat", json=replacement_body, headers=AUTH)
    assert replay.json() == replacement.json()


def test_two_turns_replay_server_history_and_owner_isolation(api):
    client, fake = api
    created, create_body = create(client)
    same = client.post("/api/chat/conversations", headers=AUTH, json=create_body)
    assert same.json()["conversationId"] == created["conversationId"]
    room = created["conversationId"]
    first = {
        "conversationId": room,
        "expectedConversationVersion": 0,
        "requestId": str(uuid4()),
        "message": "first question",
        "locale": "en",
    }
    first_reply = client.post("/api/chat", json=first, headers=AUTH)
    assert first_reply.status_code == 200, first_reply.text
    assert first_reply.json()["conversation"]["version"] == 1
    second = {
        "conversationId": room,
        "expectedConversationVersion": 1,
        "requestId": str(uuid4()),
        "message": "what next?",
        "locale": "en",
        "styleContext": {"kind": "video", "lookId": "untrusted"},
        "recentMessages": [{"id": "fake", "role": "user", "text": "untrusted"}],
    }
    reply = client.post("/api/chat", json=second, headers=AUTH)
    assert reply.status_code == 200, reply.text
    assert reply.json()["conversation"]["version"] == 2
    prepared, principal = fake.requests[-1]
    assert principal == "user:user-ok-1"
    assert [entry.text for entry in prepared.recent_messages] == ["first question", "answer-1"]
    assert prepared.style_context is None
    replay = client.post("/api/chat", json=first, headers=AUTH)
    assert replay.status_code == 200 and replay.json()["answer"] == "answer-1"
    assert replay.json()["conversation"]["version"] == 1
    assert len(fake.requests) == 2
    conflict = client.post("/api/chat", json={**first, "message": "different"}, headers=AUTH)
    assert (conflict.status_code, conflict.json()["code"]) == (409, "request_conflict")
    for path in (
        f"/api/chat/conversations/{room}",
        f"/api/chat/conversations/{room}/requests/{first['requestId']}",
    ):
        assert client.get(path, headers=OTHER).status_code == 404
    history = client.get(f"/api/chat/conversations/{room}", headers=AUTH).json()
    assert [m["text"] for m in history["messages"]] == [
        "first question",
        "answer-1",
        "what next?",
        "answer-2",
    ]
    status = client.get(
        f"/api/chat/conversations/{room}/requests/{first['requestId']}", headers=AUTH
    )
    assert (
        status.json()["status"] == "COMMITTED" and status.json()["response"]["answer"] == "answer-1"
    )

        calls = downstream.calls[start_calls:]

        cards = [item for item in display["options"] if item["outcome"] == "eligible"]
        assert [item["candidate"]["optionId"] for item in cards] == (
            ["sale-9"] if version == 1 else []
        )
        if version == 1:
            assert display["options"][2]["outcome"] == "unknown"
            evidence_id = public["knowledge"]["evidence"][0]["id"]
            assert public["knowledge"]["claims"][0]["citations"] == [evidence_id]
            assert f"{skin_case.CARE_ADVICE} [1]" in public["answer"]
            assert evidence_id not in public["answer"]
        else:
            assert planner_inputs[-1]["previousGoal"]["maxPriceKRW"] == 20000

        replay = client.post("/api/chat", headers=AUTH, json=request)

        assert len(traces) == len(planner_inputs) == version

        assert detail["context"]["compound"]["candidates"][-1]["optionId"] == "sale-10"
        with psycopg.connect(dsn) as conn:

            ).fetchone()
            namespaces = conn.execute(
                "SELECT checkpoint_ns FROM checkpoints WHERE thread_id=%s "

                "UNION SELECT checkpoint_ns FROM checkpoint_writes WHERE thread_id=%s",
                (str(thread),) * 3,
            ).fetchall()
            checkpoint_bytes = conn.execute(

        forbidden = (b"sale-9", b"chunk8", b"fixture-rag", skin_case.QUESTION.encode())
        assert all(
            marker not in bytes(blob or b"") for (blob,) in checkpoint_bytes for marker in forbidden

                ],
            }
        )

    client, _ = api
    monkeypatch.setattr(get_settings(), "g8_enabled", True)
    reply = skin_case.resolved_ingredient_reply(monkeypatch)
    consult = skin_case.AsyncMock(return_value=skin_case.Consultation(reply=reply, trace={}))
    monkeypatch.setattr(skin_case.specialists, "consult_knowledge", consult)
    downstream = skin_case.SkinApi()
    original = httpx.AsyncClient
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        httpx, "AsyncClient", lambda **kw: original(transport=httpx.MockTransport(downstream), **kw)
    )
    extractor = skin_case.IngredientExtractor()

    class Planner(skin_case.Planner):
        calls = 0

        async def complete_with_tools(self, messages, tools, *, required_tool=None):
            if required_tool in {"interpret_consultation_change", "plan_consultation_entry"}:
                return await super().complete_with_tools(
                    messages, tools, required_tool=required_tool
                )
            if required_tool == "extract_knowledge_search_conditions":
                return await extractor.complete_with_tools(
                    messages, tools, required_tool=required_tool
                )
            self.calls += 1
            response, ms = await super().complete_with_tools(
                messages, tools, required_tool=required_tool
            )
            f = response["choices"][0]["message"]["tool_calls"][0]["function"]
            plan = json.loads(f["arguments"])
            turn = self.calls
            if turn > 1:
                plan["action"] = "refine"
                plan["goal"].update(maxPriceKRW=15000, wantsKnowledge=False)
                plan["question"] = ""
            if turn == 3:
                plan["removeKnowledgeIngredients"] = ["글리세린"]
            if turn >= 4:
                plan["goal"]["goals"] = ["sensitivity"]
            if turn in {5, 7}:

@pytest.mark.parametrize("live", [False, True])
def test_execution_control_cancel_replace_pg(api, monkeypatch, record_property, live):
    import asyncio
    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
    from threading import Event

    from app.clients.llm_client import LlmClient
    from app.services.consultation_parent_graph import run_independent_reads

    if live and os.environ.get("G8_EXECUTION_LIVE") != "1":
        pytest.skip("Explicit live synthetic model cancellation run only")
    client, _ = api
    entered, release = Event(), Event()
    calls, model_calls = [], []
    original_send = httpx.AsyncClient.send

    async def send(http, request, *args, **kwargs):
        if request.url.host == "api.openai.com":
            model_calls.append({"host": request.url.host, "status": None})
            entered.set()
        result = await original_send(http, request, *args, **kwargs)
        if request.url.host == "api.openai.com":
            model_calls[-1]["status"] = result.status_code
        return result

    monkeypatch.setattr(httpx.AsyncClient, "send", send)

    class ControlledChat:
        async def answer(self, req, principal):
            if req.message == "replacement":
                from app.schemas.consultation_parent import ConsultationParent, ParentTask
                from app.services.consultation_result_service import finalize_result

                response = ChatResponse(answer="replacement result", products=[])
                response._consultation_parent = ConsultationParent(
                    tasks=[ParentTask(goal="product", status="completed", version=1)]
                )
                return finalize_result(response)

            async def first():
                calls.append("first")
                if live:
                    model = LlmClient(
                        os.environ["LLM_BASE_URL"],
                        os.environ["LLM_API_KEY"],
                        os.environ["LLM_MODEL"],
                        60,
                    )
                    reply, _ = await model.complete_with_tools(
                        [{"role": "user", "content": "세안 후 보습 순서를 간단히 설명해줘."}], []
                    )
                    answer = reply["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
                else:
                    entered.set()
                    assert await asyncio.to_thread(release.wait, 20)
                    answer = "late synthetic result"
                return ChatResponse(answer=answer, products=[])

            async def second():
                calls.append("second")
                return ChatResponse(answer="must not run", products=[])

            await run_independent_reads(
                req.message,
                {"knowledge": first, "style": second},
                {},
                check_active=req._g7_execution.check_active,
            )
            return ChatResponse(answer="must not commit", products=[])

    client.app.dependency_overrides[get_chat_service] = lambda: ControlledChat()
    room = create(client)[0]["conversationId"]
    request_id = str(uuid4())
    body = {
        "conversationId": room,
        "requestId": request_id,
        "expectedConversationVersion": 0,
        "message": "controlled initial",
        "locale": "en",
    }
    cancel_path = f"/api/chat/conversations/{room}/requests/{request_id}/cancel"
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as pool:
        pending = pool.submit(client.post, "/api/chat", json=body, headers=AUTH)
        try:
            assert entered.wait(20)
            assert client.post(cancel_path, headers=OTHER).status_code == 404
            cancelled = client.post(cancel_path, headers=AUTH)
            assert cancelled.status_code == 200, cancelled.text
            assert cancelled.json()["status"] == "INTERRUPTED"
            assert cancelled.json()["conversationVersion"] == 0
            assert client.post(cancel_path, headers=AUTH).json() == cancelled.json()
            replacement_id = str(uuid4())
            replacement = client.post(
                "/api/chat",
                headers=AUTH,
                json={**body, "requestId": replacement_id, "message": "replacement"},
            )
            assert replacement.status_code == 200, replacement.text
            assert replacement.json()["conversation"]["version"] == 1
            assert replacement.json()["consultation"]["status"] == "completed"
        finally:
            release.set()
        late = pending.result(timeout=80)
    assert late.status_code == 409 and late.json()["code"] == "request_interrupted"
    assert calls == ["first"]
    assert client.post("/api/chat", headers=AUTH, json=body).json()["code"] == "request_interrupted"
    committed = client.post(
        f"/api/chat/conversations/{room}/requests/{replacement_id}/cancel", headers=AUTH
    )
    assert committed.json()["status"] == "COMMITTED"
    restored = client.get(f"/api/chat/conversations/{room}", headers=AUTH).json()
    assert [m["text"] for m in restored["messages"]] == ["replacement", "replacement result"]
    assert (
        restored["messages"][-1]["displayPayload"]["consultation"]
        == replacement.json()["consultation"]
    )
    record_property(
        "execution_control",
        json.dumps(
            {
                "modelConfiguredMode": "live" if live else "mock",
                "actualModelHttpCalls": len(model_calls),
                "modelEvents": model_calls,
                "pg": "live",
                "auth": "mock",
                "scheduler": "real parent",
                "specialist": "controlled test",
                "calls": calls,
                "cancelStatus": cancelled.json()["status"],
                "lateStatus": late.status_code,
                "replacementVersion": 1,
                "savedMessages": 2,
            },
            ensure_ascii=False,
        ),
    )

class SkinApi:
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []
        self.options = [f"sale-{rank}" for rank in range(1, 11)]
        self.fail_ids = set()

    def __call__(self, request):
        body = json.loads(request.content)
        path = request.url.path
        self.calls.append((path, body))
        rows = []
        for rank, option_id in enumerate(self.options, 1):
            row = match(body["detectedConcerns"][0]["goal"] if path.endswith("/v4") else "pores")
            row["product"].update(id=f"p{rank}", nameKo=f"시험 상품 {rank}")
            if rank == 9:
                row["product"].update(brand="예시랩", nameKo="데일리 보습 로션")
            row.update(optionId=option_id, optionName=f"{rank * 10}ml")
            rows.append(row)
        if path == "/api/recommendations/skincare/v4":
            return httpx.Response(
                200, json=payload(tuple(c["goal"] for c in body["detectedConcerns"]), matches=rows)
            )
        assert path == "/api/catalog/options/search"
        if set(body["productIds"]) & self.fail_ids:
            return httpx.Response(503)
        items, products = [], []
        for scope in body["optionScope"]:
            rank = int(scope["productId"][1:])
            # The source contains one confirmed option at rank 9 and one partial label at rank 3.
            amount = 18500
            present = rank != 9
            label_unknown = rank == 3
            source = {"sourceRef": "https://example.test/label", "sourceVersion": "fixture-label"}
            checks = [{"condition": "identity", "verdict": "MATCH", "reason": "exact", **source}]
            price_ok = amount <= body["maxPriceKRW"]
            checks.append(
                {
                    "condition": "price",
                    "verdict": "MATCH" if price_ok else "NOT_MATCH",
                    "reason": "snapshot_price",
                }
            )
            checks.append(
                {
                    "condition": "ingredient",
                    "ingredientName": "향료",
                    "operator": "excludes",
                    "verdict": "UNKNOWN" if label_unknown else "NOT_MATCH" if present else "MATCH",
                    "reason": "absence_not_verifiable"
                    if label_unknown
                    else ("ingredient_present" if present else "ingredient_absent"),
                    "evidenceId": f"label-{rank}",
                    "observedAt": STAMP,
                    "reviewStatus": "verified",
                    "normalizationStatus": "verified",
                    "ingredientCoverage": "partial" if label_unknown else "full",
                    **source,
                }
            )
            checks.extend(
                {
                    "condition": "ingredient",
                    "ingredientName": condition["ingredientName"],
                    "operator": condition["operator"],
                    "verdict": "MATCH",
                    "reason": "ingredient_present"
                    if condition["operator"] == "includes"
                    else "ingredient_absent",
                    "evidenceId": f"label-{rank}",
                    "observedAt": STAMP,
                    "reviewStatus": "verified",
                    "normalizationStatus": "verified",
                    "ingredientCoverage": "full",
                    **source,
                }
                for condition in body["ingredientConditions"]
                if condition["ingredientName"] != "향료"
            )
            group = (
                "EXCLUDED"
                if not price_ok or present and not label_unknown
                else ("REFERENCE_ONLY" if label_unknown else "ELIGIBLE")
            )
            items.append(
                {
                    **scope,
                    "sourceVersion": "fixture-label",
                    "group": group,
                    "checks": checks,
                    "price": {
                        "amountKRW": amount,
                        "requestedBasis": body["priceBasis"],
                        "observedBasis": "collected_snapshot",
                        "observedAt": STAMP,
                        "checkedAt": STAMP,
                        **source,
                    },
                }
            )
            if group != "EXCLUDED":
                products.append(rows[rank - 1]["product"])
        return httpx.Response(
            200,
            json={
                "effectiveRequest": body,
                "checkedAt": STAMP,
                "status": "PARTIAL"
                if any(i["group"] == "REFERENCE_ONLY" for i in items)
                else "SUCCESS",
                "items": items,
                "products": products,
                "checkedScope": {
                    "candidateProducts": len(items),
                    "candidateOptions": len(items),
                    "checkedOptions": len(items),
                    "unidentifiedOptions": 0,
                    "exhaustive": True,
                    "stoppedReason": "COMPLETE",
                    "errors": 0,
                },
                "excludedCount": sum(i["group"] == "EXCLUDED" for i in items),
                "omittedCount": 0,
            },
        )

class Planner:
    configured = True

    async def complete_with_tools(self, messages, tools, *, required_tool=None):
        if required_tool in {"interpret_consultation_change", "plan_consultation_entry"}:
            state = json.loads(messages[-1]["content"])
            args = {"planId": state["planId"], "version": state["version"], "action": "continue"}
            return {
                "choices": [
                    {
                        "message": {
                            "tool_calls": [
                                {
                                    "function": {
                                        "name": required_tool,
                                        "arguments": json.dumps(args),
                                    }
                                }
                            ]
                        }
                    }
                ]
            }, 0
        if required_tool == "extract_knowledge_search_conditions":
            return {
                "choices": [
                    {
                        "message": {
                            "tool_calls": [
                                {
                                    "function": {
                                        "name": required_tool,
                                        "arguments": '{"conditions":[]}',
                                    }
                                }
                            ]
                        }
                    }
                ]
            }, 0
        assert required_tool == "plan_skin_consultation"
        decision = {
            "scope": "consultation",
            "action": "start",
            "goal": GOAL.model_dump(mode="json", by_alias=True),
            "question": CARE_QUESTION,
        }
        call = {
            "type": "function",
            "id": "plan-1",
            "function": {
                "name": required_tool,
                "arguments": json.dumps(decision),
            },
        }
        return {"choices": [{"finish_reason": "tool_calls", "message": {"tool_calls": [call]}}]}, 0

def test_binding_rejects_invalid_plan_and_late_result():
    binding = InputBinding(source_task="P1")
    base = {"goal": GOAL, "plan_id": uuid4(), "plan_version": 2}
    product = TaskRequest(**base, task_id="P1", agent="recommend")
    verify = TaskRequest(
        **base, task_id="V1", agent="verify", depends_on=["P1"], input_bindings=[binding]
    )
    assert graph.validate_plan([verify, product]) == ["P1", "V1"]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Unresolved dependency"):
        graph.validate_plan([verify])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        graph.validate_plan([product.model_copy(update={"depends_on": ["V1"]}), verify])
    late = TaskResult(
        task_id="P1",
        plan_id=product.plan_id,
        plan_version=1,
        input_fingerprint="old",
        status="complete",
    )
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Stale specialist result"):
        graph.bound_candidates(verify, binding, late)

        {"goal": "sensitivity", "sources": ["conversation"]}

@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_three_turn_goal_change_through_chat_service(monkeypatch, connections):
    from app.services.conversation_context import read_context, updated_context

    api, skincare, catalog = connections
    monkeypatch.setattr(get_settings(), "g8_enabled", True)
    install_knowledge(monkeypatch)

    class TurnPlanner(Planner):
        turn = 0

        async def complete_with_tools(self, messages, tools, *, required_tool=None):
            reply, usage = await super().complete_with_tools(
                messages, tools, required_tool=required_tool
            )
            if required_tool == "plan_skin_consultation":
                self.turn += 1
                function = reply["choices"][0]["message"]["tool_calls"][0]["function"]
                decision = json.loads(function["arguments"])
                if self.turn > 1:
                    decision["action"] = "refine"
                    decision["goal"].update(
                        goals=["sensitivity"],
                        wantsProducts=self.turn == 3,
                        wantsKnowledge=self.turn == 2,
                    )
                    decision["question"] = "민감함 관리 방법은?" if self.turn == 2 else ""
                function["arguments"] = json.dumps(decision)
            return reply, usage

    chat = ChatService(None, TurnPlanner(), catalog, skincare=skincare)
    saved = {}
    for turn, utterance in enumerate(
        [QUESTION, "모공 말고 민감함 관리 방법만 설명해 줘.", "그 목표로 제품을 다시 추천해 줘."], 1
    ):
        request = ChatRequest(message=utterance, locale="ko")
        request._compound_context = read_context(saved).compound
        response = await chat.answer(request)
        assert response.compound is not None
        saved = updated_context(saved, response)
        restored = read_context(saved).compound
        if turn == 2:
            assert restored.candidates == [] and restored.candidate_goals is None
    calls = [body for path, body in api.calls if path.endswith("/v4")]
    assert len(calls) == 2
    assert calls[-1]["detectedConcerns"] == [{"goal": "sensitivity", "sources": ["conversation"]}]

def resolved_ingredient_reply(monkeypatch, name="글리세린"):
    from app.services.knowledge_service import resolve
    from tests.test_knowledge_service import check, verification

    fixture = install_knowledge(monkeypatch).return_value.reply
    sentence = f"{name} 성분이 포함된 제품을 선택하세요."
    fixture.evidence[0].quote = sentence
    fixture.evidence[0].end_utf16 = len(sentence.encode("utf-16-le")) // 2
    draft = {
        "claims": [
            {"claim": "근거 없는 첫 주장", "citations": ["E1"]},
            {"claim": sentence, "citations": ["E1"]},
        ],
        "limitations": "",
    }
    audit = verification(
        check(1, requirements=["R1"], citations=["E1"], label="UNSUPPORTED"),
        check(2, requirements=["R1"], citations=["E1"]),
    )
    return resolve(draft, audit, fixture.evidence)


class IngredientExtractor:
    configured = True
    calls = 0

    async def complete_with_tools(self, messages, tools, *, required_tool=None):
        self.calls += 1
        assert required_tool == "extract_knowledge_search_conditions"
        reply = json.loads(messages[-1]["content"])["knowledge"]
        claim = reply["claims"][0]
        name = "판테놀" if "판테놀" in claim["claim"] else "글리세린"
        condition = {
            "ingredientName": name,
            "operator": "includes",
            "claimIndex": 0,
            "evidenceId": claim["citations"][0],
            "quote": claim["claim"],
        }
        return {
            "choices": [
                {
                    "message": {
                        "tool_calls": [
                            {
                                "function": {
                                    "name": required_tool,
                                    "arguments": json.dumps({"conditions": [condition]}),
                                }
                            }
                        ]
                    }
                }
            ]
        }, 0

@pytest.mark.parametrize("user_unresolved", [False, True])
async def test_unresolved_knowledge_preserves_user_query_and_deferred_state(
    monkeypatch, connections, user_unresolved
):
    from app.schemas.catalog import OptionIngredientResolution
    from app.services.conversation_context import read_context, updated_context

    api, skincare, catalog = connections
    reply = resolved_ingredient_reply(monkeypatch)
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        specialists,
        "consult_knowledge",
        AsyncMock(return_value=Consultation(reply=reply, trace={})),
    )
    original = catalog.search_options
    requests = []

    async def search(request):
        requests.append(request)
        result = await original(request)
        if user_unresolved or any(
            c.ingredient_name == "글리세린" for c in request.ingredient_conditions
        ):
            result.items = []
            result.status = "PARTIAL"
            result.checked_scope.stopped_reason = "INGREDIENT_CONFIRMATION"
            result.ingredient_resolutions = [
                OptionIngredientResolution(
                    ingredient_name="향료" if user_unresolved else "글리세린",
                    operator="excludes" if user_unresolved else "includes",
                    status="unresolved",
                )
            ]
        return result

    monkeypatch.setattr(catalog, "search_options", search)
    first = await graph.run_compound(
        GOAL, CARE_QUESTION, skincare, catalog, llm=IngredientExtractor()
    )
    context = read_context(updated_context({}, first)).compound
    assert all(
        any(
            c.ingredient_name == "향료" and c.operator == "excludes"
            for c in request.ingredient_conditions
        )
        for request in requests
    )
    if user_unresolved:
        assert len(requests) == 2
        assert not context.knowledge_search.deferred_ingredients
        assert all(o.outcome == "unknown" for o in first.compound.options)
        return
    assert len(requests) == 3  # first batch retries once; second uses known deferred state
    assert context.knowledge_search.deferred_ingredients == ["글리세린"]
    assert first.compound.options[8].outcome == "eligible"
    assert "조건은 적용하지 않았어요" in first.answer
    requests.clear()
    await graph.run_compound(
        GOAL.model_copy(update={"max_price_krw": 19000, "wants_knowledge": False}),
        "",
        skincare,
        catalog,
        previous=context,
        reuse_candidates=True,
        llm=IngredientExtractor(),
    )
    assert len(requests) == 2
    assert all(len(r.ingredient_conditions) == 1 for r in requests)

            plan = json.loads(f["arguments"])
            plan.update(action="refine", question=data["utterance"])
            if "민감함" in data["utterance"]:
                plan["goal"].update(goals=["sensitivity"], wantsProducts=False)
            else:
                plan["knowledgeAction"] = "reevaluate"
            f["arguments"] = json.dumps(plan)
            return response, ms

    chat = ChatService(None, UsagePlanner(), catalog, skincare=skincare)
    for message in [
        "검색 조건은 다시 적용해 줘. 세럼은 아침에 발라도 돼?",
        "모공 말고 민감함 관리로 바꿀래. 세럼과 크림은 어떤 순서로 발라야 하는지 방법만 설명해 줘.",
    ]:
        req = ChatRequest(message=message, locale="ko")
        req._compound_context = state
        before = len(api.calls)
        result = await chat.answer(req)
        state = read_context(updated_context({}, result)).compound
        if "민감함" in message:
            assert state.goal.goals == ["sensitivity"]
            assert state.candidates == [] and state.candidate_goals is None
            assert len(api.calls) == before
        else:
            assert not state.knowledge_search.cleared
            assert {"ingredientName": "글리세린", "operator": "includes"} in api.calls[-1][1][
                "ingredientConditions"
            ]
        assert consult.call_args.args[0] == message
        observations.append(
            {
                "input": message,
                "goal": state.goal.model_dump(by_alias=True),
                "candidateCount": len(state.candidates),
                "toolRequests": api.calls[before:],
                "modelConfiguredMode": "mock",
                "actualRemoteModelCalls": 0,
            }
        )
    record_property("usage_advice", observations)

@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_skin_parent_usage_only_preserves_goal_without_product_tools(
    monkeypatch, connections
):
    from app.services.conversation_context import prepare_request, updated_context

    api, skincare, catalog = connections
    monkeypatch.setattr(get_settings(), "g8_enabled", True)
    consult = install_knowledge(monkeypatch)

    class FollowupPlanner(Planner):
        async def complete_with_tools(self, messages, tools, *, required_tool=None):
            response, ms = await super().complete_with_tools(
                messages, tools, required_tool=required_tool
            )
            fn = response["choices"][0]["message"]["tool_calls"][0]["function"]
            incoming = json.loads(messages[-1]["content"])
            plan = json.loads(fn["arguments"])
            if incoming.get("previousGoal"):
                plan.update(action="refine", question=incoming["utterance"])
                plan["goal"] = {
                    **incoming["previousGoal"],
                    "wantsProducts": False,
                    "wantsKnowledge": True,
                }
            fn["arguments"] = json.dumps(plan)
            return response, ms

    service = ChatService(None, FollowupPlanner(), catalog, skincare=skincare)
    first = await service.answer(ChatRequest(message=QUESTION, locale="ko"))
    raw = updated_context({}, first)
    before = len(api.calls)
    followup = prepare_request(
        ChatRequest(message="상품은 됐고 사용 순서만 알려줘", locale="ko"), raw, []
    )
    result = await service.answer(followup)
    assert len(api.calls) == before
    assert result.compound.goal.goals == GOAL.goals
    assert result.compound.goal.wants_products is False
    assert result.style_recipe is None
    assert consult.call_args.args[0] == followup.message
    assert result._consultation_parent.plan_id == first._consultation_parent.plan_id
